hero: Autologic Industries is an IATF 16949 certified manufacturer in Delhi and an auto parts supplier for Sri Lanka. We export three-wheeler and motorcycle clutch systems, brake shoes, engine parts and aluminium castings.

Three-wheelers are a familiar sight on every Sri Lankan road, working as taxis and small goods carriers from Colombo to the hill country. Motorcycles are just as common for commuting. Both need replacement parts that fit well and last. Browse the range below. Every part is tested in our plant before it is packed for export to Colombo.

network.title: Why Sri Lankan Buyers Choose Us
paras: We have made drivetrain parts for two and three wheelers for more than 25 years, and every component is tested before dispatch.
One manufacturer for clutch, brake and casting parts means simpler ordering and consistent quality across your range.
Our team can cross-check your current part numbers against our range, so you know which three-wheeler and motorcycle parts we can supply.

network.title: Shipping Parts to Sri Lanka
paras: Orders travel by sea in palletised export packing to Colombo, with the invoice, packing list and other documents your clearing agent needs.
Three-wheeler, motorcycle and casting items can be combined in one container, and repeat shipments can be scheduled.
Moisture-protected packing helps parts stay in good condition in humid coastal warehouses.

cta.title: Sourcing parts for the Sri Lankan market?
cta.text: Share your part list, models or drawings with quantities. Our export team will confirm fitment and send a quotation for delivery to Sri Lanka. Samples can be arranged before your first volume order.

faq_intro: Quick answers for importers, distributors and workshops in Sri Lanka.
faqs: Do your three-wheeler parts fit common Sri Lankan models?
Our clutch assembly specifications list Bajaj RE, Piaggio Ape, TVS King and other models. Share your model to confirm fitment.
Can I order motorcycle and three-wheeler parts together?
Yes. We combine product lines in one consignment and label cartons by model.
Do you make parts to drawings?
Yes. Our die casting and CNC lines produce components from drawings or samples after a feasibility review.
Can I check quality before ordering in bulk?
Yes. Order samples first, and volume production will follow the approved specification.
Do you supply brake shoes for three-wheelers?
Yes. Our drum brake shoes have fade-resistant linings and are designed for quiet, smooth braking.
